gap_details.expression:
Let $n_{\rm tot}=n_f+n_g$. The current upper-to-lower ratio is at most $$
\widetilde{O}\!\left(\frac{n_{\rm tot}+\sqrt{n_{\rm tot}}\kappa^{7/2}\varepsilon^{-2}}{n_{\rm tot}+\sqrt{n_f}\kappa^2\varepsilon^{-2}}\right).
$$. The lower bound does not yet establish a leading $\sqrt{n_g}$ term for every component split.
gap_details.region: The joint window in component count and condition number.

settings.search_text: BL_SPEC_uniform_penalty_pl Bilevel optimization with nonunique lower minimizers: uniform perturbed PL conditions and exact gradients.
